multiplier.freeze_scope: all seeds, anchors, candidates, routes, and offsets

source_grammar.eligible_anchor: Main proposes a physical departure and at least four offsets remain
source_grammar.focal_sampling: uniform without replacement from eligible departure users using a domain-separated preoutcome schedule RNG
source_grammar.candidate_rule: hold incumbent when legal; otherwise choose maximum predecision candidate_sinr legal non-Main rival
source_grammar.tie_break: ascending physical NORAD ID, cell ID, then action ID
source_grammar.fallback_score_provenance: current observation candidate_sinr evaluated against previous-step radiating set
source_grammar.schedule_seal: discover and hash the complete seed schedule before computing any z2 for that seed

retention.support_loss: right-censor with branch side, offset, user, physical key, and reason
retention.other_error: retain exact class and message; never impute or substitute

service_guard.served_count: candidate served count is not lower than reference
service_guard.focal: a reference-served focal user remains candidate-served

decision.scientific_no_go: instrument conditions pass but positive criterion fails
decision.instrument_fail: any contract, seal, keyed-field, offset, numeric, or non-mutation violation
decision.indeterminate: coverage minimum cannot be met or an infrastructure error remains after at most two logged retries

forbidden_decision_inputs: legacy C2 certificate pass or margin
go_authorizes_only: one separately preregistered bounded learnability pilot on a non-overlapping seed block
